subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world algebra word problems using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student works through an unknown-quantity scenario using virtual mystery-box objects
exercise.pictorial: Student draws a bar model with an unknown labeled section to represent a word problem
exercise.abstract: Student writes and solves a one-step equation from a word problem, explaining their reasoning

misconception_flags: cannot translate word problem language into an algebraic equation

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
